product_overview: SSP Global’s frontend website presents the organization’s dual focus on software training and software solutions through an interactive single-page experience. It showcases key sections like leadership, student success, and company strengths while also collecting prospective inquiries through a contact form.
core_goals: Help visitors understand SSP Global’s two divisions: Software Training Institute and Software Solutions
Present the organization’s leadership and value proposition in an engaging, scroll-driven layout
Let visitors explore student success and company differentiators through interactive content
Capture basic inquiries from interested students or clients via a contact form

features.name: Sticky Header & Responsive Navigation
features.description: Provides persistent access to the site’s main sections and a mobile-friendly menu for smaller screens.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the page -> See the header remain visible -> Open a section from the navigation links -> Arrive at the selected section
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu -> View the navigation links -> Select a section -> See the menu close and the page move to that section

features.name: Interactive Hero Canvas
features.description: Displays a scroll-driven hero experience with frame-by-frame canvas animation and phased messaging.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll down through the hero area -> See the canvas animation advance frame by frame -> Observe the title phase fade in -> Continue scrolling -> Observe the introductory message and call to action appear -> Continue scrolling -> See the final location-focused message appear

features.name: S-Split Transition Section
features.description: Introduces the two main divisions with interactive cards for the training institute and software solutions.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Welcome section -> See the two division cards appear -> Hover over the STI card -> See the card scale and reveal its interactive emphasis
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Welcome section -> See the two division cards appear -> Hover over the SS card -> See the card scale and reveal its interactive emphasis

features.name: Leadership Section
features.description: Shows the company’s leadership team in a structured quote-card layout with photos, titles, and supporting statements.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the leadership section -> View the leadership cards laid out horizontally -> Read the titles and quotes for the CEO, Director, and Founder

features.name: Features Section
features.description: Highlights key reasons to choose SSP Global in a grid of value propositions with sequential entrance animations.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the features section -> See the value proposition cards fade in sequentially -> Read the listed benefits

features.name: Student Success Accordion
features.description: Presents student support principles in a three-item accordion that keeps only one item expanded at a time.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Student Success section -> Expand one accordion item -> Read its description -> Expand another accordion item -> See the first item collapse and the new item open
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the Student Success section -> Expand each accordion item one at a time -> Read the descriptions for Individual Tracking, Standalone Mindset, and Lifetime Support

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Collects basic lead information through a simple enquiry form with name and phone number fields.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact form -> Fill in the name -> Fill in the phone number -> Submit the enquiry form -> See the form accept the entry
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact form -> Leave a required field empty -> Submit the enquiry form -> See the browser indicate that required information is missing

features.name: Interactive Hero Canvas
features.description: Scroll-driven canvas animation with text phases
user_interactions: Scroll down to trigger frame-by-frame animation
See text fading in and out sequentially

features.name: S-Split Transition Section
features.description: Two cards revealed on scroll with hover interactions
user_interactions: Hover over STI card to see scaling effect and explore button
Hover over SS card to see scaling effect and explore button

features.name: Student Success Accordion
user_interactions: Click on an accordion header to expand it

features.name: Navigation Header
features.description: Sticky header with mobile menu toggle
user_interactions: Click hamburger icon to toggle mobile menu
Click links to scroll to specific sections

known_limitations.issue: Contact form does not connect to backend
known_limitations.impact: Data is not saved when submitted
